audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Skill, Lissandra, Skill, Skill while the content layer and packet levelChart read Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra. Six of seven rows disagreed.
audit.why: Level 1 Pantheon has no Shield Vault, so it is even; levels 2-5 are his all-in window on a 13s stun; from first item onward Lissandra's lockdown and self-R outscale his single-target burst.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved onto the content values, with phases[1..3].why rewritten to argue Pantheon's window instead of Lissandra's.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d called Shield Vault a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s. Fifteen is not a rank of it.
audit.corrected: Changed to thirteen, matching rank 1, and the cooldowns field now carries both ends of the range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer states three times that Pantheon's passive 'blocks your first auto or spell'. It does not. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit, and Aegis Assault's channel was never mentioned.
audit.why: Mortal Will reads: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' There is no block. The damage-blocking is Aegis Assault (E), a 22s frontal invulnerability that is a channel — and any CC cancels a channel, which makes W-root and Frozen Tomb the direct answers to it.
audit.corrected: Replaced the passive-block claim with Mortal Will's real empowerment, and stated that rooting or tombing him cancels Aegis Assault.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief flagged that Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset and that Aegis Assault grants untargetability; neither reached the page.
audit.why: The reset means the auto lands with the stun rather than after it, so the vault wind-up is the cue, not the landing.
audit.corrected: Recorded in the cooldowns field and the don'ts bullet about clawing into a banked Shield Vault.

audit.why: 55.29% over 2232 games is consistent with an even-to-favourable lane that flips at 6.

notes: Six of seven full-layer sides disagreed with the content layer and the packet chart; the full layer was moved onto the content values, so no win[N] flips were required, and the whys for the three rows that changed verdict were rewritten in the same proposal. The biggest factual fix is the passive: the content layer said three times that Mortal Will blocks your first auto or spell — it does not; Riot's text only empowers his next spell. The blocking effect belongs to Aegis Assault, which is a channel and therefore cancellable by your W-root or your ultimate. | COHERENCE: 1 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
